changelog:
Automated Tweet Scheduler 1.0.0 – initial release:

- Schedule tweets and threads with queue system and optimized posting times.
- Visual content calendar with drag & drop, edit, and delete for scheduled posts.
- Thread builder with visual editing, preview, and auto-break features.
- Engagement analytics including best times, growth, and top tweets.
- Media support: upload images, videos, GIFs, and set alt text.
- Available plans: Free, Pro, and Business with flexible tweet limits.
